units.source_text: 三十年前，本所还残留着很多许多诸如污水沟的柳树、回向院的广场、御竹仓的杂木树林之类的自然之美。

en.t: Thirty years earlier, Honjo still retained many kinds of natural beauty, such as the willows by the drainage ditches, the square of Ekoin, and the thickets of mixed trees around the Otake storehouses.

units.source_text: 他没办法和他的朋友一样，去日光或者镰仓。

en.t: He could not go to Nikko or Kamakura the way his friends did.

units.source_text: 但是，每天早上他都会跟着父亲一道儿在他家附近散步。

en.t: But every morning he would go for a walk near his house together with his father.

units.source_text: 对于当时的信辅来说，这就是最大的幸福。

en.t: For Shinsuke at that time, this was the greatest happiness of all.

units.source_text: 然而，他不好意思跟朋友得意的讲述这种幸福。

en.t: And yet he was too embarrassed to boast to his friends about this happiness.
